changes_made.explanation: Removed generic 'BERT' as it's redundant with 'BERT-Base-Uncased'. Normalized output description to be more concise.
The paper uses retrieval metrics (P@5, MAP, MRR) to evaluate FAQ retrieval performance, not NLG evaluation metrics. No automatic metrics are used to evaluate the generated paraphrases themselves.
No LLMs are used as judges/evaluators in this paper. GPT-2 is used for generation, not evaluation.
No human evaluation of the generated paraphrases is conducted in this paper.

overall_notes: This paper focuses on FAQ retrieval using generated paraphrases for training, but does not evaluate the quality of the generated paraphrases themselves. The evaluation is on retrieval performance using standard IR metrics. The NLG component (paraphrase generation) is used as a means to an end (improving retrieval) rather than being the primary focus of evaluation.
